The Farmhouses in DAMAC Hills 2 promise a unique blend of luxury and eco-friendly living, providing a serene countryside experience within Dubai. This exclusive development by DAMAC includes just 13 spacious farmhouses in 5 and 6-bedroom configurations, each surrounded by lush greenery and ample outdoor spaces designed for relaxation. 

With its thoughtfully designed layout and quick access to communal facilities, major roads, and popular city landmarks, luxury living at The Farmhouses DAMAC Hills 2 combines the best of upscale comfort with a peaceful, nature-inspired lifestyle.

The farmhouses in DAMAC Hills 2 for sale offer an exceptional blend of luxury and modern living, designed to cater to those who appreciate expansive spaces and high-end amenities. These G+2 residences are available in two unique styles: The European Style and The North American Style, each offering distinct features to suit diverse tastes. 

The European-style farmhouses, inspired by the serene meadows of Belgium and the Netherlands, cover 5,040 sq. ft. and include spacious living areas, a fitted kitchen, and a maid’s room. These homes also boast private parking, a pool, and versatile outdoor spaces ideal for a horse stable, garden, or animal barnyard.

On the other hand, the North American-style farmhouses are expansive, covering 8,387 sq. ft., and feature large bedrooms, an office, and generous living spaces. These units stand out with west-inspired amenities such as a hydroponic farm, an outdoor cinema, a sunken fire pit, and a flower garden. 

Residents can also enjoy a private pool, dedicated parking, and a barbecue area, making these farmhouses in DAMAC Hills 2 for sale the perfect blend of elegance and outdoor lifestyle.

Buying a Property in The Farmhouses, DAMAC Hills 2

Buying a farmhouse in DAMAC Hills 2 is an excellent opportunity for those seeking luxurious country-style living. Interested buyers and investors can explore options for spacious 5 and 6-bedroom farmhouses in this exclusive development. 

The price trends for these premium properties are competitive, with 5-bedroom farmhouses available between AED 6.2M and AED 6.9M. For those interested in even more expansive layouts, purchasing a 6-bedroom farmhouse will range from approximately AED 11M to AED 11.8M, offering unmatched luxury and ample space.

more_info.question: FAQs About The Farmhouses, DAMAC Hills 2

data.answer:
What types of properties are available in The Farmhouses at DAMAC Hills 2?

The Farmhouses offer spacious 5 and 6-bedroom residences in two distinct styles: European and North American, complete with luxurious amenities and ample outdoor space.

What is the payment plan for properties in the community?

DAMAC Properties provides an attractive payment plan for investors. You can secure your property with a 20% down payment, while 50% can be paid in easy installments during the construction phase. The remaining 30% is due upon handover, offering flexibility and convenience to buyers.

What amenities are available for fitness enthusiasts in The Farmhouses?

The community offers fully-equipped gyms, outdoor fitness areas, and scenic walking and cycling trails, making it ideal for those who enjoy an active lifestyle.
